notes.title: Switching to Free
notes.content: Ice Caves of Europa will be switching to Free to Download from October 20th, 2022.

notes.title: 3D print your own Dragonfly
notes.content:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/TightAggressiveIvorybackedwoodswallow-size_restricted.gif[/img]

If you have a 3D printer you can now print your own Dragonfly drone. The files are available to [url=https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:3200795]download for free from Thingiverse here.[/url]

notes.title: Available now
notes.content: Ice Caves of Europa is available to buy now at a special launch discount of 10% off for one week. The game has full controller support and is available on PC and Mac.

notes.title: Release date announced - July 10th
notes.content: Ice Caves of Europa will be available to buy on July 10th! You can see the new trailer on the store page now. Special thanks to our beta testers, and thanks to everyone who has already put the game on their wishlist - we can't wait for you to play it soon.
